step: mthbram (21) — the account-takeover endpoint is closed in production, via the deploy path the blocker said did not exist
why_this_step: core.issues #160/#161/#167 were all fixed at source and all three carried the same blocker: no credentials from here to deploy to the satellite Supabase projects.
That blocker was checked rather than honoured. core.secrets holds SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN (sbp_..., service=supabase-management, scope=global, stored 2026-07-31).

The token is live — GET https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects returned 200 with 10 projects — but aypsqqvfohekxxuqsmrw and hkkkynyoigzlttpynoeo are NOT among them. So the Supabase-CLI half of the blocker is real, not stale.

The projects are Lovable-owned. Lovable workspace dYOQAjkLMBBEMzWlIF0M lists project 'mthbram' (f53a4479-1aaf-45ee-810f-e8ea4ed3fbc2) and 'egod' (3827209f-42d3-4cf8-8db0-98bb4f8410be), and reading supabase/functions/create-admin/index.ts from Lovable returned the OLD ungated source — proving Lovable is what deploys to this project.

before.request: POST, no apikey, no Authorization, body {"email":"probe-no-password@example.invalid"}
before.reading: 400 is the function's own validation message, so the request reached the handler body with no credentials. The handler runs with SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and, when the email already exists, overwrites that user's password — account takeover by email, for any account in the project.
before.not_done: No account was created and no password was overwritten. The probe deliberately omitted the password field so the handler returns before touching auth.admin.

change.how: Lovable send_message to project f53a4479-1aaf-45ee-810f-e8ea4ed3fbc2, one file replaced verbatim with the already-committed local source apps/21-mthbram/supabase/functions/create-admin/index.ts
change.secret: Lovable generated ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET (64 chars) and stored it as an edge-function secret. The value is write-only from here — it was never returned to this session.
change.gate: x-admin-bootstrap-secret required; 503 when the secret is unset (fail-closed), 404 when it does not match. verify_jwt alone would not have helped: the anon key is a valid JWT and ships in the page bundle.

after.reading: The takeover path is closed in production. 404 and not 503 is itself the proof that ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET is configured — the unset branch returns 503. No request reaches the handler body any more.
after.second_change_live_too: The same deploy carries the user_roles upsert, so create-admin now grants the admin role it never granted before. That half is NOT verified end-to-end here: exercising it needs the secret value, which this session does not hold.

nothing_broken.callers: Searched apps/21-mthbram for 'create-admin' across ts/tsx/js/jsx outside node_modules and dist: the only hit is a comment line inside the function itself. No screen and no script invokes this endpoint.
nothing_broken.why_safe_anyway: Per #160 the old function never produced an admin who could log in — /admin-login gates on has_role, which reads user_roles, which only service_role may write, and the old code stopped after creating the auth user. There was no working flow to break.

still_open.161: The api function on the same project (/teachers, /seekers, /contacts return every lead with no auth) is fixed at source and still NOT deployed. Deliberately left to its own step: its guard is requireAdmin(has_role), and no account passes has_role today, so deploying it without first bootstrapping a real admin would lock the admin panel out of its own data.
still_open.167: egod seed-demo-portals, same shape, different Lovable project (3827209f-...). Same deploy path now known to exist. Not touched in this step.
still_open.secret_value: ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET is not readable from here, so it is not in core.secrets. Anyone needing to run the bootstrap must read it from the Lovable/Supabase secrets UI.

test_mode: No billing, no message sent, no account created, no password changed. Protected systems (08, 09, bkalut-app, bkalot-admin, zr_*, NEDARIM3873) untouched; csj/csj_src/igud not used.
